fields.label: Gateway URL
fields.description: Base URL of the Baileys gateway, e.g. http://localhost:3001

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Shared secret sent as X-API-Key header to and from the gateway.

fields.label: Session Name
fields.description: The Baileys session name configured on the gateway.

fields.label: Connected User
fields.description: User credited as the owner of messages typed on the phone (mirrored back via Baileys). Falls back to Administrator if unset.

fields.label: Placeholder Email Domain
fields.description: Domain used for synthetic email addresses (group tickets and unknown contacts).

fields.label: Unknown Contact Action
fields.options:
Skip Ticket Creation
Create Ticket Only
Create Contact and Ticket
fields.description: What to do when a DM arrives from a number not matched to any Contact.

fields.label: New Conversation Timeout (Hours)
fields.description: For DMs: reuse the existing ticket if the last message was within this window. Groups always use one persistent ticket.

fields.label: Status on Customer Reply
fields.description: Set ticket to this status when a customer sends a message.

fields.label: Status on Agent Reply
fields.description: Set ticket to this status when an agent replies.

fields.label: Append Agent Initials to Outgoing Messages
fields.description: When enabled, appends ^XX (agent initials) to every outgoing Baileys message.

fields.label: Restrict Chats by Team Assignment
fields.description: When enabled, agents only see chats assigned to their team. Unassigned chats are visible to all. Agents with no team see everything.

fields.label: Notification Quiet Period (Minutes)
fields.description: Skip the bell notification if an agent already replied within this many minutes. 0 = always notify.

fields.label: WhatsApp Groups
fields.description: Map each group JID to a friendly name and optional team override.

fields.label: Blocked Numbers / Groups
fields.description: Messages from these JIDs or phone numbers are silently dropped — no ticket, no notification.
